newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fresh massacre in Algeria, 44 slain - residents.
newsitem.headline: Fresh massacre in Algeria, 44 slain - residents.

text.p: Suspected Moslem fundamentalists massacred 44 people on Sunday night in an isolated hamlet south of Algiers, residents said on Monday.
They said the bodies were discovered by gendarmes on Monday morning 1.5 km half (one mile) from Larba, 25 km (15 miles) from Algiers.
About 15 more people were missing, residents said, with some saying they had probably fled into the mountain to escape and others saying they had more likely been kidnapped.
